bot_team_backup.title: Bot-team backup
bot_team_backup.note: Optional. Off unless the recorded setup answer is yes. This floor does not copy documents by itself.

lines.follow_the_recipe: When bootstrap/USER.md records bot-team backup as yes, follow guides/BOT_TEAM_BACKUP.md. Write each bot's name, prompt, settings, routines and skills to bot-team/<bot>.md. Revise a document only when it changed. Supersede; do not delete.
lines.no_secrets: Never store secret values, tokens, passwords or card data in a bot-team document. Connectors, logins and secrets are reconnected by hand. Name those items in bot-team/RECOVERY.md. Do not write the values.

reassertion: Bot-team backup stores no secret values.
